answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 8470 Country: India Title: I have digestive problem as such my wazoo breaks frequetly, i am not able to hold it for long , alongwith with i have got peshab ka katra girne ka problem.... a) As i am working in india and many a time i often have to pray two to three time namaz along with isha prayer at night can i perform with one wazuu? Some body sugested that after doing wazuu , i will have to do masah ( pat on the floor place of sajda & once masah of face and then of my hands upto elbow) For katra Problem i wrap the pennis with tissue paper so that it does not touch any of my clothes. In this codition can i perform my namaaz? I intend to go for Umrah , what i know of is cannot wear in undergarments or any stiched close in ehram , since i have this katra problem and passing of wind problem pls guide me how to do Umrah ? Lokking forward to your early reply Allaha hafiz. Question: Q1.As-salam mu alikum, Sir. I have digestive problem as such my wazoo breaks frequetly, i am not able to hold it for long , alongwith with i have got peshab ka katra girne ka problem.... a) As i am working in india and many a time i often have to pray two to three time namaz along with isha prayer at night can i perform with one wazuu? Some body sugested that after doing wazuu , i will have to do masah ( pat on the floor place of sajda & once masah of face and then of my hands upto elbow) For katra Problem i wrap the pennis with tissue paper so that it does not touch any of my clothes. In this codition can i perform my namaaz? I intend to go for Umrah , what i know of is cannot wear in undergarments or any stiched close in ehram , since i have this katra problem and passing of wind problem pls guide me how to do Umrah ? Lokking forward to your early reply Allaha hafiz. Answer ID: 8470 Posted on: Aug 28, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2270/1866=B/1429) You will be considered mazoor (excused) if you are unable to pass any time of salah in which you can perform salah being pure and clean. You will have to make fresh ablution at the beginning of every salah and offer the salah ; the salah will be valid even if urine and wind comes out. There is no need do masah after making ablution, the person who told you to do so is wrong. You must go to Umrah, but do not wear knickers in the state of Ihram. You should also pray to Allah Almighty to cure you from the diseases, most probably Allah will give you shifa and you will get rid of the troubles. You should wrap up tissue paper while performing Umrah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
